title: 第2章夺舍圣女
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
“这么说来，如果我夺舍了天生剑体，去练练剑，岂不是相当于我也拥有了剑体天赋?要是夺舍了修为高深的大能，稍加修炼，不就等于平白得了十几年苦修?“

    摸着下巴，季南北点了点头。

    嗯，不愧是金手指，果然可靠!

    不过，季南北忽然又想到一个问题：自己的魂魄去夺舍了，那原本的身体怎么办?

    仿佛感应到季南北的疑问，系统面板上浮现出解答。

    [夺舍期间，宿主身躯将进入自动托管状态，尽量避免与他人交流，自动进行闭关修炼，具备低程度自主恢复能力。若发生重大事件，将提示宿主魂魄。]

    “哇，考虑得真周到。“

    感慨一句，季南北直接打开夺舍面板。

    上面目前有两个空位，季南北点击后，提示弹出：

    [请选择夺舍目标，或进行随机夺舍。]

    季南北此刻身在快活林魔宗，方圆几十里内，除了那位可能存在的师尊，恐怕再无人烟。

    于是，季南北自然选择了随机夺舍。

    眼前一黑。

    随即，一阵轻微的眩晕感传来。

    接着，系统面板在黑暗中浮现。

    [夺舍成功，正在载入修为及天赋数据，请稍候......]

    [载入完成!]

    境界：金丹九层

    天赋一，琉璃剑心：心无杂念，唯剑相伴，可搬山，倒海，降妖，镇魔，敕神，摘星，断江，摧城，开天。(剑道悟性极致，所有剑招威力提升三至十倍。)

    天赋二，同阶无敌：同境界内难觅对手，越阶战斗易如反掌，无需多问，只因根基深厚，底牌层出。(面对同阶敌人战力提升三成，越阶战斗时战力提升七成，当前境界圆满时，战斗中有较高概率触发临阵突破)

    天赋三，正道魁首：年轻一辈正道领军人物!(气势效果增强十倍。对非正道敌人有一定概率触发被动威慑。)

    季南北：???望着这华丽到极致的属性面板，季南北整个人都呆住了。

    金丹九层?!这放在普通小门派里，都够当一派之主了!即便是修行界的大宗，这等修为也足以担任执事，掌管一方事务。

    当今修行界，分为练气，筑基，金丹，元婴，化神，返虚，羽化七大境界，其中羽化境亦称登仙境，即是传说中的仙人之境。

    每个境界又分九层。

    四十岁前能筑基便算可造之材，百岁之内结丹已是天才中的天才。
content_en:
"So, if I take away my natural sword body and practice swordsmanship, doesn't it mean that I also have the talent of sword body? If I take away my high-level cultivation and practice a little bit, doesn't it mean that I have spent more than ten years of hard training in vain?"

    Touching his chin, Ji Nanbei nodded.

    Well, it is indeed a golden finger, it is indeed reliable!

    However, Ji Nanbei suddenly thought of another question: If his soul was taken away, what would happen to his original body?

    As if sensing Ji Nanbei's question, the answer appeared on the system panel.

    [During the body seizure, the host's body will enter an automatic trusteeship state, try to avoid communicating with others, automatically engage in retreat practice, and have a low level of autonomous recovery capabilities. If a major event occurs, the host soul will be notified. ]

    "Wow, that's very thoughtful."

    With a sigh, Ji Nanbei directly opened the body seizing panel.

    There are currently two vacancies above. After Ji Nanbei clicks, a prompt pops up:

    [Please select a target to capture the body, or conduct a random capture. ]

    Ji Nanbei was currently in the Happy Forest Demon Sect. Within a few dozen miles, except for the possible master, there was probably no one around.

    Therefore, Ji Nanbei naturally chose to seize the body randomly.

    His vision went dark.

    Immediately, a slight feeling of dizziness came.

    Then, the system panel emerged from the darkness.

    [Seize the body successfully, loading cultivation and talent data, please wait...]

    [Loading completed!]

    Realm: ninth level of golden elixir

    Talent 1, Glazed Sword Heart: No distracting thoughts in the mind, only the sword to accompany it, it can move mountains, overturn seas, subjugate monsters, suppress demons, command gods, reach for stars, break rivers, destroy cities, and open the sky. (With the ultimate understanding of swordsmanship, the power of all sword moves is increased by three to ten times.)

    Talent two, invincible at the same level: It is difficult to find opponents in the same realm, and fighting across levels is easy. No need to ask, just because the foundation is deep and the trump cards are emerging. (When facing enemies of the same level, the combat power is increased by 30%. When fighting across levels, the combat power is increased by 70%. When the current level is perfect, there is a higher probability of triggering a breakthrough during the battle)

    Talent Three, Leader of the Righteous Path: The leader of the younger generation of the Righteous Path! (The momentum effect is increased ten times. There is a certain probability of triggering passive deterrence against non-righteous enemies.)

    Ji Nanbei: Looking at this extremely gorgeous attribute panel, Ji Nanbei was stunned.

    Ninth level of golden elixir?! In an ordinary small sect, this is enough to be the leader of a sect! Even for a large sect in the cultivation world, this level of cultivation is enough to serve as a deacon and take charge of the affairs of a party.

    Today's world of spiritual practice is divided into seven realms: Qi training, foundation building, golden elixir, Yuanying, spiritual transformation, returning to the void, and feathering. Among them, the feathering realm is also called the fairyland, which is the legendary realm of immortals.

    Each realm is divided into nine levels.

    Anyone who can build a foundation before the age of forty is considered a talent, and someone who can form a core within a hundred years is considered a genius among geniuses.
title_en: Chapter 2 The Holy Maiden Who Seized the Body
